# contextify

> Tell every coding agent how your repo works. Then prove it is still true.
>
> contextify is an Agent Skill that writes a short AGENTS.md and thin editor pointers. It reuses
> accurate existing documentation first and can add docs/context/architecture.md or workflows.md
> when needed, each capped at 120 lines. Factual managed lines map to repository evidence.
> Installed Git hooks check at commit and push; session hooks are explicitly opt-in.
> The deterministic checker makes no model or network calls and never rewrites context.
> Git checks inspect the working tree, not staged snapshots or pushed refs, and warn by default.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/README.md): What contextify is, who it is for, how to install and use it.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/skills/contextify/SKILL.md): The skill definition read by Claude Code and every other agent through the skills CLI.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): Install, draft, review, commit context and evidence, then activate Git checks safely.
- [Install in your editor](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/editors.md): The `npx skills add` one-liner and the `-a` code, install paths and context file for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Windsurf, Zed, Continue.dev and Kimi Code CLI.
- [Supporting documents](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/supporting-docs.md): When to reuse existing docs or add evidence-backed architecture and workflow notes.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/faq.md): Short answers to the questions people actually ask, from why AGENTS.md is the source to whether the hook ever rewrites a file.
- [Honest limits](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/limits.md): What a clean run does not prove, opening on the line that a verified command was never executed and citing the ETH Zurich finding on context files.
- [Hooks and CI](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/hooks.md): Default Git pre-commit/pre-push setup, safe activation, migration from session defaults, optional host adapters and CI.
- [Comparison](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): contextify against ruler, rulesync, ClaudeForge, agentrules-architect, airul, agents-md-generator and the built-in `/init` commands, scoped to what each was actually read to do.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a problem in contextify itself.
- [LICENSE (MIT)](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/LICENSE): Permissive MIT license.

## Install

- Plugin (recommended): `claude plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/contextify` then `claude plugin install contextify@contextify-marketplace`.
- Skills CLI, any agent: `npx skills add Aboudjem/contextify -a claude-code`, swapping the `-a` code for your agent.
- Manual: `git clone https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify`, then copy `skills/contextify` into your agent's skills directory. Copy the whole directory: `references/` and `scripts/` load by relative path.

## Skill

- [Skill directory](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/tree/main/skills/contextify): `SKILL.md` plus `references/`, loaded only when a run reaches the area a reference covers.
- [Scripts](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/tree/main/skills/contextify/scripts): the deterministic layer, `ctx-check`, `ctx_write.py`, `ctx_stamp.py`, `verify_claims.py`, `install_hooks.sh`. The model writes a draft; only these scripts touch a target file.
- Every pointer file generated (`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, the optional `.mdc`, the Copilot instructions file) links back to `AGENTS.md` rather than duplicating it.

## Examples

- `examples/`: a real Next.js dogfood snapshot and explicitly labelled tiny/Python teaching fixtures, with full generated instructions, pointers and evidence.

## Optional

- [Evals](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/tree/main/evals): deterministic checks and behavioral scenarios. Skip if a shorter context is needed.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history. Skip if a shorter context is needed.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose a change. Skip if a shorter context is needed.
- `READMEs/` translations: they may lag the English README. Skip if a shorter context is needed.
